tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mchod phreng dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur ba thar pa dam pa'i gru rdzings zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru sarbā ya/ chos rnams mngon gyur pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /don dam 'gyur med phag nag zhal dang bcas// nyon mongs gcod byed phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la rtag tu 'dud// mtshan nyid dang ldan nges pa'i lung gis phyug /spangs rtogs mthar phyin de nyid bcu dang ldan// bzod ldan drang la rgyud kyi sbyor ba mkhas// dpal ldan bla mas bdag blo'i mun pa sel// rnal 'byor byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis// dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur ba dang*// skal ldan rim gnyis bsgom pa'i phyir/ */ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// cho ga'i rim pa gsal ba gang*// las can don du bri bar bya// de yang dus ma nges pa dang gang yang rung ba'i dus su/ dur khrod sogs gnas rab tu dben par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bris sku'i mdun du nang mchod sgrub rdzas sogs yo byad gang dgos rnams/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nyer bsdogs byas la bdud rtsi'i chu bran zhing*/ bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i ngag tu 'di skad brjod do// rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gnyis dang ldan pa'i rnam pa chu las nya ldang ba ltar gyur/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ oṃ khaṃ aṃ trāṃ dang*/ bāṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las sgron ma lnga dang bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa sa bon gyis mtshan pa rlung gis bskyod cing me rab tu 'bar bas rdzas dang sa bon rnams 'od du zhu ba li khri'i mdog ltar gyur pa'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga |de'i lte bar yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse rnams bsdus te bstim/

slar yang phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang dbyer med du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ bdud rtsi rang gi lag g.yon gyi srin lag gis blangs te lce thog tu myang ngo*// mchod pa byin brlab ni/ bdud rtsi 'thor zhing ngag tu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i dang las a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa lta bu stong gsum gang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dgyes pa bskyed nus pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapada'i bar sbyar te rol mo'i sgra dang bcas so// sngon 'gro'i gtor ma bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phe/ཾ gtor mgron phyogs bcu'i zhing skyong*/ mkha' 'gro/ 'byung po/ bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye nas gtor ma bteg pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ un+mā da/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu| sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha ya sa hā yi kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*| |'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ */mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod| |dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// byad stems ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs sna tshogs 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ ngag tu/ gdod ma nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo la bye brag tu gzugs sogs phung po rnams ni rtag pa sogs dang*| sa khams ni ltung byed ma sogs dang*/ mig sogs skye mched rnams ni gti mug rdo rje sogs su lhag par gnas pas rab tu rnam par dag pa'o// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyogs bzhir sngags de nyid las grub pa'i khwa gdong ma/ 'ug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir gshin rje brtan ma la sogs bzhi ste/ lha mo brgyad kyang rang mdog can rang rang gi phyag mtshan can du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje ra ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas khyab cing brtan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ slar yang lha mo rnams ra ba la thim pas me dang*/

rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po gcig tu sra zhing brtan pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ ces rtse gcig tu bsgom/ de nas/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod la/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// gang dag 'gro ba'i bsam dbye bas// sna tshogs sku ni rnam par 'dzin// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la bzhugs pa'i// mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang*// dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi la 'dud| |he ru ka dpal mchog tu rab dgyes pa'i// 'o mtsho yid 'ong zla ba'i 'od byed ma// 'gyur med bde ba'i rang bzhin lha mo yi// lhun grub dpal gyis bdag la skyong gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /zung 'jug bde chen spros bral pho brang nas| |bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// gnyis med mkha' dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas// rgyal sras til+li pa la gsol ba 'debs// gsal stong 'ja' tshon lta bu'i pho brang nas// mkhas mchog nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// rang lus lha skur dag pa'i pho brang nas// zung 'jug brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs| |rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// bar chad mi mthun 'joms mdzad pho brang nas// bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// rkyen ngan bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/

rang nyid tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ slar yang hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus gang*/ 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig sgrib dang nyams chag nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dag /lus sems la lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes kyi bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ su puṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpas khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag go gsungs zhing rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

/oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar po gdengs ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo yi ge baṃ dmar po gnas pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhal gnyis ma/ g.yas phag zhal nag pos ngur sgra sgrog cing nam mkha' la gzigs pa/ rtsa zhal dmar po spyan gsum mnga' ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la gdengs pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing mchan khung du thabs shes mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing phyed sil bur thur du 'phyang ba/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rin po che'i rtse phran gyis spras pa/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rkang mthil g.yon pa'i brla la sbyar ba/ g.yon pas ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnan pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang baṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa lhan cig tu spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa/ oṃ badz+ra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dang huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa thog mthar sbyar/ badz+ra waṃ she/ badz+ra mṛ taṃ ge/ badz+ra mu rañdze/ badz+ra hā s+ya/ badz+ra lā s+ya/ badz+ra gī ti/ badz+ra nṛ t+yai/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra dī pe/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ oṃ rū pa badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ra sa badz+ri/ spar+she badz+ri/ dharma dhā tu badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bdag nyid la mchod par gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar sbyar la mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsung thugs// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// rab 'bar byu ru'i phung po rab mtho ba// mu tig phreng bas yongs su brgyan pa bzhin// phyag rgya lnga yis sku la rab brgyan cing*// nu 'bur rgyas pa do shal 'od kyis mdzes// 'od zer tshogs rnams khyod kyis yongs 'dzin pa// ma lus 'gro ba sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ thod pa lag tu thogs la lag g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis gtor zhing ngag tu/ rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// lak+ṣiṃ ka ra dpal ldan bir+wa pa// a wa dhū ti grub chen sha wa ri// dpal ldan ldom bu bla ma sangs rgyas sbyin| |hūm̐ chen ka ra kun dga' badz+ra dang*// bla ma skyi ston lha rje ston pa'i zhabs// dar ma bsod nams bla ma brag chen pa// ri khrod dbang phyug thugs sras chos rje dang*// legs pa mgon po badz+ra bkra shis dang*// byang chub bzang po ngag dbang grags pa'i mtshan// dkon mchog rin chen kun dga' rat+na sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes dang*/ 'khyud pa'i rgyas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi lte bar baṃ la sngags bdun gyis bskor bas phyogs bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po dag dang*/ steng du phag zhal nag po'i smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar po gnas par gyur pa'i 'og gzhir sngags phreng rlung dang bcas pa sna bug nas thon/ 'gro ba rnams kyis kyang de rnams su byas shing steng zhal gyis sna bug g.yas su zhugs/ g.yon pa nas thon rang gi sna bug g.yon par zhugs lte ba dga' 'khyil dang bcas pa 'khor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus kyis bsnyen pa bskyal/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bdag bskyed la mi dgos/ de nas mchod cing bstod la/ bum pa gnyis la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab cing bgegs bskrad la/ sman dang bcas pa'i chus sum gnyis bkang zhing gtso bo'i steng du dung chos sman chus gang ba gzung thag gis brgyan pa bshams la/ ngag tu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa sogs mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa lha'i gos kyis dkris shing dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs par gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ las bum gyi nang du pad nyi ro'i gdan la dum skyes ma sku mdog dmar mo rgyan dang phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bo oṃ/ zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de rnams la thim par gyur gyi bar bgyi/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngar ltar byas la/

chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo mchod yon ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo zhabs bsil ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhabs bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /pā d+yaṃ= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo me tog ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje me tog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /puṣ+pe= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo bdug spos ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje bdug spos ma yis mnyes gyur cig |dhū paṃ= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo snang gsal ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ /rdo rje snang gsal ma yis mnyes gyur cig /ā lo ke= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo dri chab ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje dri chab ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gan+dhe= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo zhal zas ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul| |rdo rje zhal zas ma yis mnyes gyur cig /nai wi d+ye= chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo sgra snyan ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje sgra snyan ma yis mnyes gyur cig /shapad= zhes mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lokya mā te ma hā bīd+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā wa he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te wa sh+yaṃ ka ri ni tra bh+rā ma ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyas par 'dod na stong nyid snying rje ma sogs brjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'phros/ bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar thim zhing 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus thugs kar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la bsnyen pa bya/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ ces gshegs su gsol lo// de nas rnal 'byor pa gang zhig dbang sngon du mnos shing bsnyen pa tshad dang ldan zhing lha la gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ slob ma snod dang ldan pa la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed bsgrub cing dkyil 'khor bri ba'i thabs bstan pa ni/ phag mo mngon 'byung gi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor chos 'byung nyis brtsegs ra ba bzhi ldan gyi tshul du gsungs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ snying po'i 'khor lo sgo bzhi rta babs 'khor yug dang bcas par gsungs pa dang*/ sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'khor yug gsum ldan du gsungs pa sogs bzhed lugs mi 'dra ba mang du 'dug kyang 'dir mngon 'byung gi rgyud kyi dgongs pa sor gnas te/ de yang dus ni| nyi ma zla ba gzas zin dang*// ya mtshan che ltas byung ba dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// bsgrims te dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes pa'i dus nges pa can dang*/

gnas ni dur khrod dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gang yang rung bar slob ma sta gon zur nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ de nas sa bzung ba dang*/ bsrung ba/ bslang ba sogs dang sgrub khang gi phyogs bsrung ba sogs spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas stegs bu tshad dang ldan pa'i steng du ba'i lci ba dang spos kyi chag chag btab cing las kyi thig gdab pa ni/ shar nub tshangs thig dang por gdab// dbus dang mtha' gnyis mtshan ma bya// thig chen gzhan rnams spyi dang mthun// phyed tshad kyis bskor de nyid kyis// tshangs pa'i mtha' gnyis g.yas g.yon du// bya rjes btsal steng thig btab pas// chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig 'gyur// nang du cha phran re re bcad// dbus su gsum mnyam bskor ba la// ge sar mu khyud cha rer bya// 'dab bzhi'i thig gdab phyi rol du// cha chen gcig bcad phyed dgos pa// bskor bas thod phreng rdo ra'o// de phyir cha chen gnyis bskor bas// me ri dur khrod sa gzhi ste// gang dgos gsher thig dag gis mnan// zhes pa ltar gsher thig dang bcas btab ste/ ye shes kyi thig ni thig skud kha dog lnga dang ldan pa shar nub tshangs thig /steng gi thad kyi bar du bzung la bsang chu 'thor zhing bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig skud kha dog lnga ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga sku dang phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa rang rang gi mdog can sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ skya thig ltar so sor thig gdab pa'i tshul bya zhing*/

slar yang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ ces pa'i thig chog rnams yongs su rdzogs nas tshon gdab pa ni/ de yang bu ston gyi gzhung las/ rgyal pos rin chen sna lnga dang*// blon pos 'bru yi phye ma ste// sgrub pa pos ni rdo thal la// zhes pa ltar tshon kha dog lnga dang ldan pa snod so sor bsang chu 'thor zhing bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshon sna lnga rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rigs lnga phyag mtshan zhal phyag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces mchod bstod skabs dang sbyar/ sa bon rnams lnga/ bdun/ nyer gcig gang rung bzlas la/ badz+ra muḥ tshon gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rdul tshon dang dbyer med du gyur/ ces brjod/ tshon bkye ba ni/ lte ba ser po/ mu khyud sngon po/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma dmar po/ mtshams bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa mdzes tshon/ chos 'byung nag po/ thod phreng rdo ra me ri dur khrod rnams mdzes tshon/ phyogs kyi pad+ma la gri thod/ chos 'byung gi zur bzhir g.yung drung dang bcas pa man ngag ltar yongs su rdzogs par bris la/ tshon lhag ma rnams gtsang sar dor/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mañdza'i khar thod pa rdzas kyis bkang ba dar dmar pos bkab pa'i steng du me long la sin+dhu ras chos 'byung nyis brtsegs sa bon dang bcas pa bris pas bkab/ gzhan yang bum pa gnyis/ rdo rje/ phag mgo sogs dbang rdzas rnams yongs su tshogs pa dang*/ nang mchod gtor ma dang*/ phyi rol du mchod pa sna tshogs pas bskor la/ mched lcam rnams kyi lag tu spos dang rdor dril thogs te yig brgya brjod cing dkyil 'khor la nang du skor ba lan gsum bskor/ sgrub pa po kha shar phyogs su phyogs la dkyil 'khor la bsang chu 'thor zhing*/

oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa dmar po/ zhes pa nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur gyi bar brjod/ phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la pad nyi ro'i gdan la mdun du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing*/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ldan pa/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi rol du thod pa dang*/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ me ri/ dur khrod dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang baṃ smug nag las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las gtso mo la mi bskyod pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams lha de rnams la thim pa'i lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ zhes pa nas/ yan lag thams cad la/ phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod la/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar byas la| rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ yan lag brgyad ldan dri ma med pa'i chab// 'tsho ngom bsil sla yang ba'i mchod yon 'di| |bcom ldan snying po'i rnal 'byor ma la 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ dri ma med pa'i lha rdzas las byung ba'i// zhal bsil dam pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun 'di// glo bur nyes pa'i dri ma dag phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhal bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /ā tsa mā naṃ= sgrib gsum nyes pa'i tshogs rnams dag byed cing*// dri med ye shes ldan pa'i bsang gtor 'di// sku gsung thugs la bsang gtor 'di phul bas// rdo rje bsang gtor ma yis mnyes gyur cig /prok+ṣa ṇaṃ= nam mkha'i gos can rin thang med pa'i chab// rnam par 'thor ba'i rlung gis g.yo ba yi// chab kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje zhabs bsil ma yis mnyes gyur cig /pā d+yaṃ= zhing khams kun tu skye zhing gnas pa yi// rdo rje me tog rnam mang mchis pa kun// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje me tog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /puṣ+pe= zhing khams kun tu sbyar zhing gnas pa yi// bdug spos rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje bdug spos ma yis mnyes gyur cig /dhū pe= zhing khams kun tu sgron zhing gnas pa yi// snang gsal rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// rin chen mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje snang gsal ma yis mnyes gyur cig /ā lo ke= zhing khams kun tu 'phro zhing gnas pa yi// dri mchog rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje dri mchog ma yis mnyes gyur cig /gan+dhe= zhing khams kun tu sbyin dang gnas pa yi// ro mchog rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// las kyi mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje zhal zas ma yis mnyes gyur cig /nai wi d+ye= zhing khams kun tu grag cing gnas pa yi// sgra snyan rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun// chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma la 'bul lags na// rdo rje sgra snyan ma yis mnyes gyur cig

/oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī shapad pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ slar yang rang gi sa bon las spros pa'i 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol// oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan yid 'ong sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol// shapad= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*| |a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol// gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog brgya ldan 'di// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol// ra sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam gnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos rje btsun ma la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing bla med sgrub mchog bstsal du gsol// spar+she= sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra wā sa s+ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser las legs byas shing*// rtsibs stong ldan pa'i dpag tshad lnga brgya pa// phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar byed pa yi// 'khor lo rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/

nam mkha'i mdzod ltar re ba skong mdzad cing*// nyi ma stong las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar// dri med bai ḍūr+ya yi rin chen mchog /nor bu rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// ma ṇi rat+na= 'khri shing gzhon nu bzhin du lus phra zhing*// bzhin ras rgyas pa zla ba'i mdzes pa 'phrog /ut+pal mig can dga' bzhi mchog ster ma// btsun mo rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// s+t+rī rat+na= kun gyi gnas dang gter la rten byed cing*// rgol ba gzhan gyis brdzi bar mi nus shing*// tshogs gnyis rin chen gter la longs spyod pa// khyim bdag rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// gṛ ha pa ti rat+na= theg chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan zhing*// dman pa'i 'jigs pa dag las rgyal byed kyi// sa la rab brtan lta bur bgrod gyur pa// glang po rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// hasti rat+na= sprin gyi shugs can cang shes kun gyi gtso// myur mgyogs rta bdun khengs pa 'phrog byed cing*// rdzu 'phrul mkha' la thogs med 'gro ba yi// rta mchog rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// a shwa rat+na= gang gi yid la 'dod pa'i dpal dag gis// rig shes gnas la mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyis// lhun grub 'bad pa med par spyod byed pa'i// blon po rin chen gus pas dbul bar bgyi// oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī pa ri ṇā ya ka rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod cing*/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ri bo chen po'i lho phyogs na// u rgyan rang byung dur khrod na| |ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri// rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung*// chu klung thams cad khrag dang zhag /sa gzhi thams cad keng rus la// sgra skad thams cad hūm̐ dang phaṭa// khro bcu rgyu ba mi nus shing*// stobs chen thams cad 'joms pa'i sa// yum mchog rdo rje phag mo de na bzhugs// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// phyag 'tshal mchod pa rab tu 'bul// ma yi sku mdog dmar ser 'od du 'bar ba las// bde chen nyams dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhabs gnyis gar stabs skyil krung phyed pa las| |bdud bzhi thal bar rlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// spyan gsum ldang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa las// snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// zhal gnyis rab gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa las// skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// don dam rang bzhin phag zhal nag po las// chos sku 'gyur ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba las// bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// phyag g.yon bhan+dha khrag bkang bsnams pa las// rtog med zas la rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum|

|thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa las// rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba las// sems can bde la 'god pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba las// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ nam mkhar phyar ba las// gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// de la mi mgo gsum gyis brgyan pa las// dug gsum gnad du bsnun pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje 'khor los rab tu brgyan pa las// phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// dar sna lnga yi ba dan phyar ba las// yon tan nub pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gser gyi bum pa rab tu ldir ba las// chos sku yon tan 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ḍā ma ru yi sil sgra 'khrol ba las// shes rab snyan rgyud 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yu ba drang zhing dkar la ldem pa las// bdud kyi rgyal mtshan bsnyel ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// rdo rje phyed pa thur du bstan pa las// dgra bgegs g.yul ngo zlog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba las// gsang sngags rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa las// chos rnams ma lus bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// ro yi gdan la dgyes par bzhugs pa las// rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa las// nyon mongs rnam rtog bsregs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// gcer bu sku mdog dpal gyi be'u las// 'dod chags bde bar bsgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum// 'di rnams thams cad ma yi sprul pa ste// khro mo'i gzugs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbang phyug gtso mo khyod la bdag bstod do// lha mo khyod la bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes bstod la|

rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs kar thim zhing 'khor bar gyur/ ces snying po bzla/ de nas nang gtor ni sngon 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ a kā ro lan gsum brjod/ lha mo rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ snying po'i sngags la khā hi btags la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma| |sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ phyi gtor ni sgrub grogs la dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ phyi rol du gtor ma/ mchod pa rnam lnga bshams la sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs skyong gi tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis bkug par gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya ma/ wa ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ ma hā bhū ta/ ag+ni/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bā yu de wa ta/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ brah+ma/ ā d+ya de wa/ be ma tsi tri/ pṛ thi wī de wa ta/ rnams kyi rjes su/ sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes btags pa dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ tṛp+ta sarba de wa ta sā dha ka s+ya/ shān+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi kuṃ ru/ sarba kar+yan+tu sid+dhirbaha wan+tu ya thā su khaṃ su kheḥ zhes spyan drangs la/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar brjod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sogs brjod la/ lhag chad yi ge brgya pas kha bskang zhing gshegs su gsol/ skabs 'dir dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon du mi rung ba'i gang zag la ni bsnyen pa'i grangs ma gsungs te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yin la/ dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon du rung ba la ni bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad kyang gsungs te/ a bha yā ka ras/ rdzogs ldan dus kyi sngags pas 'bum phrag gcig /gnyis ldan dus su sngags pas 'bum phrag gnyis// gsum ldan dus su 'bum phrag gsum du 'gyur// bye ba phrag gsum 'bum bzhi rtsod dus sbyar// zhes pa ltar gtso mo la 'bum dang*/

mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la khri re/ sgo mtshams ma dang gshin rje bzhi la stong phrag re/ dkyil 'khor la yang des mtshon/ bum bskyed kyi gtso mo la khri dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la stong phrag re/ sgo mtshams ma dang gshin rje bzhi la brgya rtsa re ste/ de ltar bsnyen tshad rnams yongs su rdzogs pas slob ma la dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur na/ las bum gyis khrus bya zhing bgegs bskrad la/ bu ga dgur dri'i thig le bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor 'dug ste sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig gam bdun brjod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa che// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol| |sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag kyang gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba la dmigs te bdun rnam dag dang sdom pa gzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su| |byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi| |sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa yi// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbug ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum brjod/

slob dpon gyis rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ deng khyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlabs kyi/ rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba dam pa 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// gal te brnyas par gyur na rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod bdud rtsi myang zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub/ sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan/ zhes so/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes mig dar sbyin| a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog sbyin/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la yid kyis phyag bya bar mos la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi| |gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsum brjod/ mig dar bsal zhing*/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyed kyi// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong ba yin no// zhes brjod byin dbab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phog rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gsal ba'i gsang gnas kyi gtum mo'i me sbar spyi bo'i haṃ zhu nas thig le dkar po snying gar byung zhing*/ gsang gnas kyi a shad las thig le dmar po yar byung ba snying gar gcig tu bsres pas lus thams cad zag pa med pa dang*/

dga' bde'i ye shes kyis skad cig la khyab par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma'i sgra dang bcas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ brtan par bya'o// de nas bum pa'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// ces gsum brjod/ mdun gyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i phyag gis bum pa rang gi spyi bor bzhag la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas nas byung bas sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ de ltar bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu sku rdo rje mngon du byas pa yin no// rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhe sdang rnam dag pa// rnam shes gnas gyur me long ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi thugs su grol gyur cig /ces oṃ gsum ma brjod/ bum chu 'thor zhing*/ mgo bor chu las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ dbu rgyan mgor bzhag la/ rin chen mkha' 'gro nga rgyal rnam dag pa// tshor ba gnas gyur mnyam nyid ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi yon tan rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ gsum ma brjod/ bum chu 'thor/ mgo bor chu las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ pad+ma mgor bzhag la/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'dod chags rnam dag pa// 'du shes gnas gyur sor rtog ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi gsung ni 'grub gyur cig |oṃ gsum ma brjod/ bum chu 'thor/ mgo bor chu las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan par gyur/

dril bu lag tu gtad la/ las kyi mkha' 'gro phrag dog rnam dag pa// 'du byed gnas gyur bya grub ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las rdzogs gyur cig /oṃ gsum ma brjod/ bum chu 'thor/ mgo bor chu las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gri gug sbyin zhing*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gti mug rnam dag pa// gzugs phung gnas gyur chos dbyings ye shes kyi// rang bzhin mi g.yo mchog gi dbang bskur bas// bde gshegs kun gyi sku ni 'grub gyur cig /oṃ gsum ma brjod/ bum chu 'thor zhing*/ mgo bor chu las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas brda'i dbang bzhi ni/ mda' gzhu bstan la/ 'di ni khyod kyi yab he ru ka sngon po sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ gar snang ba thabs shes ya ma bral ba gyis shig ces pa'i brda yin no// phag mgo bstan la/ 'di ni khyod kyis phag ma gtsang btsog med pa bzhin du rtog med kyi ye shes yang dag sgoms shig ces pa'i brda yin no// ka pā la bstan la/ 'di ni khyod kyis chos nyid gang du yang mi gnas shing skye 'gag 'gro 'ong byung gnas dang bral ba yin no zhes pa'i brda yin no// rdo rje rgya gram bstan la/ 'di ni khyod kyis bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pa'i tshe phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'i brda yin no// des rig pa'i dbang rnams thob/ lam bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la dbang*/ de nas gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// zhes gsum brjod bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras mchog dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyi// deng 'dir khyod la dbang bskur ro// oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bdud rtsi sbyin la/

slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su kha/ zhes bdud rtsi myang*/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi sgrib pa dag /'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang na// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje phag mo tshon gang ba zhig byung ste khyed rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin nyams su myong bar gyur/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yid kyi dri ma dag /'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis| |gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog na/ byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs/ de ni ming tsam/ brda tsam/ btags pa tsam/ des phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i brda yin te/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba ste// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes pa thams cad kyang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs te don du chos thams cad skye 'gag gnyis med/ spang blang gnyis med/ re dogs gnyis med/ mnyam rjes gnyis med/ snang sems gnyis med/ mtha' dbus rnam pa gnyis med pa'i rang gi sems nyid bcos lhad dang bral ba'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas don dam pa'i ye shes mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/

gzhan yang skabs 'dir ngo sprod rgyas par bya'o// des dbang bzhi pa thob sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba ni maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che| |dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// zhes gsum brjod/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdor dril 'dzin pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ de nas rdo rje/ dril bu/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ka pā la/ gri gug rnams lag tu gtad la/ rdo rje dril bu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ka pā la dang gri gug sogs// khyod la yang ni sbyin par byed| |slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// khyod kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ston pa dang*/ chos 'chad pa dang*/ rtsom pa la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyis bya bar rigs pa rnams gyis shig /ces gnang ba sbyin/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon la g.yon du rim pa gsum du 'khor ba la dmigs te sngags kyi rjes zlos bya/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// de nas tshogs kyi lag mchod bya ba ni/

lag g.yon gyi steng du g.yas pa'i srin lag gis bdud rtsis chos 'byung bsnol mar bris te/ dbus su oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha rnams su gyur/ sor mo rnams su oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ na ma hi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swā hā hu las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he las he ru ka mthing ga /huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog ljang gu rnams su gyur/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs kyis bstod/ tshogs g.yon skor du/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hrīṃ moṃ hriṃ hrīṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ g.yas skor du/ oṃ ha na ma hi swā hā hu bau ṣaṭa he huṃ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭa haṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yig brgya brjod/ lag par gnas pa'i lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ thal mo gnas gsum du gtugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ tshogs la bdud rtsi bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ sngon 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ 'bras rgun bu ram bcos pa'i chang*// shes rab ma da na mchod 'di// dbang bzhi'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas dbang bzhi'i don rtogs shog /ba la sha lnga 'bras 'khur dang*// thabs chen maṃ sa'i mchod pa 'di// rtog med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas chos sku thob par shog /dbang po lnga dang bcas pa yi| |sna tshogs keng rus mchod pa 'di// bde stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas longs sku thob par shog /byang sems rkang dang khu ba zhag /ga ṇa rak+ta'i longs spyod 'di| |gsal stong bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs/ */spyad pas sprul sku thob par shog /bu ram la sogs mngar gsum dang*// dkar gsum ar+ghaṃ mchod pa 'di// zag med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas skye med don rtogs shog

/'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod rnams// rigs lnga'i bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas 'khor dang myang 'das kyi// yon tan rin chen thob gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa oṃ gyi 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dkar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// bde chen sku ru 'gyur ba'i rdzas| |spyad pas rin chen chos sku la// nyams rtogs dbyer med 'phel gyur cig /gnod sems zhe sdang 'khrug pa kun// byams pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa āḥyi 'od zer gyis// 'dod chags las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// dmar la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// 'gag med gsung sgra sgrog pa'i rdzas// spyad pas gsung dbyangs drug cu yis// gdul bya ma lus tshim gyur cig /zag bcas bde ba'i nyams myong kun// zag med bde bar 'gyur bar shog /brjod pa hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis/ gti mug las gyur tshogs kyi rdzas// mthing la mdangs chags bdud rtsir gyur// gnyis med chos skur 'gyur ba'i rdzas// spyad pas sems rgyun ye shes lnga// rgyun chad med par 'phel gyur cig /rmongs shing ma rig gti mug sogs// 'od gsal chen por 'gyur pa shog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes lnga ldan pa'i// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir| |bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la sogs// dus gsum bde gshegs dpa' bo dang*// phyi nang mkha' 'gros bzhes su gsol// a la la te dgyes par mdzod// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpa' bo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa yis// bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// lus ngag yid gsum thams cad dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas su byin gyis rlobs// ngag longs spyod rdzogs skur byin gyis rlobs// sems gnyis med chos skur byin gyis rlobs| |sku gsum ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol// nang gi bar chad nang du sol// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes 'bul zhing tshogs la longs spyad par bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon la tshogs phud dbul ba ni/

las kyi rdo rjes 'di skad du/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// bdag gis tshogs kyi yo byad 'di// dang ba'i yid kyis 'bul lags na// ci bde ba ni bzhes su gsol// zhes dbul/ slob dpon gyis lan gdab pa ni/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnams spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces longs spyad/ lhag ma rnams bsdus la rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha chu bran la| a kā ro gsum brjod/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje phag mo lhag ma'i bdag /sngags las skyes dang zhing las skyes// las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas nyul zhing*// lha klu gnod sbyin sde brgyad dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas 'byung po'i tshogs// lhag mar dbang ba gang mchis pa// dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtsang sar dor zhing cho ga zhag mang sbrel na dkyil 'khor gyi shar lho'i 'gram du 'bul bar bya'o// rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ bsod nams zhing du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas la// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod yon 'di// snang stong dbyer med sems kyis 'bul lags na// bde stong zag med thugs kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil| me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo/ zhes dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ zhes sbyar zhing mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la ni phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum yum gzhan gyis mi thub rig pa'i dbang phyug che// 'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad kun tu 'bebs ma rdo rje chen mo nyid// rdo rje gdan ma mi pham gzhan gyis mi thub dbang mdzad g.yo ba can// dug kyang skem par mdzad ma 'jigs su rung ba'i khro mo gtsigs byed ma| |skrag byed gsod byed rab tu 'byed par byed cing pha rol las rgyal ma// rnam par rgyal ma rmugs par mdzad cing rengs dang rmongs par mdzad pa mo// rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces bstod la/

bzod par gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// blo dman bdag gis nongs sam nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir khyod nyid 'gro kun mgon gyur slad// nongs pa gang phyir mchog gis bzod par rigs// zhes yig brgya brjod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la phog mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus lha mo bzhi la thim/ de rnams kyang gtso mo la thim/ de yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yang rang nyid la thim/ rang gi lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de yang ches phra bar gyur te 'od zer lnga'i gong bur gyur pa de nyid kyang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsogs brjod/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ smon lam ni/ khyod nyid bsgrubs pa'i dge ba dri med gang zhig ni// bdag gis thob pa de yi srog chags phung po rnams// lus dman rab dga'i dga' bas rtag tu snying gtams nas// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub dam pa brnyes gyur cig /ces smon lam btab/ bkra shis bya ba ni/ yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// til+li'i mtshan can mkhas mchog nā ro pa// skad gnyis smra ba mar ston chos rje sogs// zung 'jug bla ma brgyud pa'i bkra shis shog /bde stong gnyis med pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /rtsa ba'i zhal gnyis 'od zer gzi brjid 'bar// thabs shes gnyis med kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi bkra shis shog /thabs mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi sku// shes rab yum gyi bha ga mtshon pa'i phyir// chos 'byung zur drug sa bon phyag mtshan dang*// 'khor yug bzhi ldan dbang gi rdzas dang bcas// rten dang brten bcas dkyil 'khor 'dis mtshon te// sangs rgyas kun yum badz+ra wā rā hī'i// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa// 'dir tshogs mched lcam rnams kyis thob gyur nas// mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'chi med rdo rje'i sku// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob pa'i bkra shis shog

/ces dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis dang smon lam gyis byin chags par bya zhing*/ sta gon rdul tshon dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor yin na rdul tshon rnams klu gnas pa'i chu mig tu klu chog dang ldan pas gshegs su gsol/ de ltar min yang rjes chog gzhung gzhan rnams kyi rigs 'gre dgos pas so// rgyud sde kun la legs par bslab sbyangs te// thos bsam sgom la blo gros cher rgyas shing*// dpal ldan bla ma dharme shwa ra yi// gsung gi gsang ba'i man ngag mdzod 'dzin pa// pha rol log rtog rgol ngan gang mchis la// zhum pa med pa'i spob pa mchog ldan zhing*// blo gros dge ba'i rgyud gzhung don bsdus nas// 'di nyid bris pa'i dge ba gang mchis pa// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*| |'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /mtshan dpes rab brgyan yan lag bdun ldan gar dgu'i nyams ldan nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs phyag gnyis thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin cing dar dang rat+nas brgyan pa'i sku// lta bas mi ngom grag stong sgra dbyangs rdo rje'i gsung mchog theg gsum gdul byar chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du rab tu bskor bas gdul bya smin// rgya mtsho lta bur gting mtha' med cing gzhal du med pa'i thugs rje'i zer gyi lcags kyus rab 'dren mi g.yo'i thugs// de lta bu yi sangs rgyas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang 'jig rten mgon po'i go 'phang dam pa mchog de bdag sogs kun gyis thob gyur cig /ces bla ma gong ma dag gis chog bsgrigs gsal bar mdzad 'dug pa las de nyid cung zad bsdus te gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ dpal rdo rje gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug gi thugs rje las gsung rab kyi don cung zad mnos pa/ shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rang lo bco brgyad pa'i thog chu pho byi ba lo'i hor zla gsum pa rta zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi nyin dge mtshan dang bcas de wī ko ṭa 'dzin pa'i tsā ri rdor 'dzin pa chen pos bskul ba las myur du grub par bgyis pa'o//
